# Change Log
All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.

The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](http://keepachangelog.com/)
and this project adheres to [Semantic Versioning](http://semver.org/).

## [0.0.1] - 2026-05-28

The commit marked "V1". This is the initial semi-working commit that I plan to use in the near future for production data.

### Added
- When online, accessible at [mush.appli.ng](https://mush.appli.ng)
  MINOR Ticket title goes here (if I had one).
- Added main data models and database connection logic
- Added basic API endpoints for creating and retrieving data
- Added basic frontend pages for viewing, creating, and editing data
- Added basic google login and session tracking functionality
- Added RFID functionality
- Added docker compose configuration for local development and deployment, as well as prod deployment

### Changed
- Everything
### Fixed
- A lot of stuff
